submission.natural_language_explanation: Broad layer-0 head: ordinary prose, code and number strings are predicted active-weak (content words, pronouns, numbers, verbs often reach 0.25-0.45 of max at most positions), and it is strong (0.6-1.0 of max) only on a comma or a determiner (' the', ' a', ' an', or repeated ' the') that sits within roughly the first five tokens of a text, where it attends mostly to itself; the same tokens fade toward zero later in a text (below the line by about position 8-10). Predicted inactive: ' and', ' of', ' from' and full stops at any position, and in particular short binomials made of single-token directional/adverb particles joined by ' and' (e.g. 'Up and down', 'In and out', 'Back and forth', 'On and on', 'Over and over', 'Down and out'), with no comma, determiner or noun.
